name: Can grab bars be installed on tiled shower walls?

mainEntity.name: Can grab bars be installed on tiled shower walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, grab bars can be safely and securely installed on tiled shower walls. This process requires specialized tools and techniques to drill through the tile without cracking it, and then anchoring the grab bar securely into the wall studs or proper blocking behind the tile. It's crucial to use appropriate fasteners and sealants to prevent moisture intrusion. City Dweller, LLC has experience installing grab bars on all types of shower wall surfaces, ensuring a watertight and structurally sound installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, grab bars can be installed on tiled shower walls. It requires specialized drilling and secure anchoring into studs behind the tile, with proper sealing to prevent water damage.
